verdict.rationale: Zulip documents an official API and a first-party bot framework for writing and running custom bots, with production deployment via the Zulip Botserver. That is a first-party developer toolkit to build against, but the evidence never names official client SDK libraries or the languages they cover. Machine-readable API specs were not found: probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDK client libraries and their languages, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
